title: AutoRAGBench: A Benchmark for LLM Agents Automating RAG System Development
abstract: arXiv:2611.25582v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a well-established paradigm for augmenting large language models (LLMs) with information retrieved from external corpora. However, developing effective RAG systems requires substantial engineering effort and iterative experimentation, as effective design choices vary across tasks and domains. With rapid advances in LLM agent capabilities, we ask how well these agents can autonomously build RAG systems and how effectively they can improve them through iteration. In this paper, we propose AutoRAGBench, the first benchmark to evaluate how well LLM agents develop RAG systems from scratch in an open code space. It comprises nine RAG system development tasks. For each task, agents build RAG systems from scratch without starter code or prescribed strategies, under a six-hour budget on a single H800 GPU. translated_title: AutoRAGBench：用于自动化RAG系统开发的LLM智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）是一种成熟的范式，通过从外部语料库检索的信息来增强大语言模型（LLM）。然而，开发有效的RAG系统需要大量的工程工作和迭代实验，因为有效的设计选择因任务和领域而异。随着LLM智能体能力的快速进步，我们提出这样一个问题：这些智能体能够多好地自主构建RAG系统，以及它们能够通过迭代多有效地改进这些系统。在本文中，我们提出了AutoRAGBench，这是第一个评估LLM智能体在开放代码空间中从零开始开发RAG系统能力的基准测试。它包含九个RAG系统开发任务。对于每个任务，智能体在没有起始代码或预设策略的情况下，在单个H800 GPU上六小时的预算内从零构建RAG系统。它们分析任务数据、实现RAG流水线，并基于实验结果迭代地优化其设计……
tldr: 本文提出了首个基准测试AutoRAGBench，通过九个任务评估LLM智能体在无起始代码和预设策略的条件下，于开放代码空间中自主从零构建并迭代优化RAG系统的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AutoRAGBench, the first benchmark comprising nine tasks that evaluates how well LLM agents can autonomously build and iteratively refine RAG systems from scratch in an open code space, without starter code or prescribed strategies.
